name: KiwiKraft
description: New Zealand's leading alloy boat manufacturer, KiwiKraft builds tough, purpose-built fishing and family vessels designed for our unique coastal conditions.

name: Ultimate Boats
description: Ultimate Boats delivers premium aluminium vessels with a focus on performance, durability, and innovative design for serious boaties.

name: FlyFin Boats
description: FlyFin specialises in high-performance alloy sportsfishing boats, built for speed and stability in New Zealand's challenging offshore conditions.

name: Fi-Glass Boats
description: Fi-Glass produces quality fibreglass runabouts and family boats that combine classic styling with modern construction techniques.

name: Senator Boats
description: Senator Boats offers a premium range of pontoon and bowrider vessels, perfect for family recreation and entertaining on the water.

name: AMC Boats
description: Auckland Marine Centre's own brand delivers exceptional value alloy boats built specifically for New Zealand conditions, backed by our full service team.

name: Challenger Boats
description: Challenger Boats are renowned for their robust alloy construction and outstanding sea-keeping ability across a comprehensive range of fishing and family models.

name: Campion Boats
description: Campion is a premium Canadian boat brand offering beautiful fibreglass bowriders, cuddy cabins, and runabouts with exceptional fit and finish.

name: Reflex Boats
description: Reflex Boats are purpose-built high-performance alloy vessels designed for New Zealand's demanding inshore and offshore fishing environments.

name: Fyran
description: Fyran builds premium alloy centre console and walk-around vessels with a focus on serious sportsfishing capability and offshore performance.

name: Legacy SLR Boats
description: Legacy SLR produces top-tier fibreglass sports cruisers and cuddy cabins that blend stunning aesthetics with outstanding on-water performance.
